dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.description: How useful each source's feedback is: a rule-based band from its length, specifics (numbers, product terms) and whether it names a concrete issue or request. A source with mostly low feedback often means a misconfigured scraper or a skipped form field.
dataQuality.empty: No feedback in this time range.
dataQuality.unratedShare: {{share}} of the feedback in this range is not rated yet.
dataQuality.backfillHint: Feedback stored before ratings existed has no band; a category reprocess (Administration → Taxonomy) rates it.
dataQuality.chartTop_one: The chart shows the busiest source; the table lists every source.
dataQuality.chartTop_other: The chart shows the {{count, number}} busiest sources; the table lists every source.
dataQuality.partial: Some data could not be read in time, so these counts may be lower than the real numbers.

profile.title: Source profile
profile.description: What each source's feedback looks like: how it is rated, its sentiment and how long its text is.
profile.notProfiled: {{share}} of the feedback in this range was stored before the profile was counted and is not included. Rebuilding the aggregates for the range adds it.
